description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyLogParser class, which is responsible for parsing monkey test log files in the Android bug reporting context. It extracts information about Application Not Responding (ANR) events from the logs.

classes.name: MonkeyLogParser
classes.description: Parser class for processing monkey log files, extracting ANR events.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse the monkey log file and update a Bugreport object with ANR information.
